Take a look glimpse at Guns of Eschaton co-op gameplay, a soulslike FPS set in an occult Wild West created by the late, renowned writer and worldbuilder Viktor Antonov (Half-Life 2, Dishonoured, Prey, Fallout 4, Wolfenstein: The New Order).
